source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit is **destroyed** once all its models are.

Once a model is destroyed, resolve any rules its destruction triggers, then remove it from the battlefield. If an attack destroyed it and such rules apply, both wait, unless stated otherwise, until the attacker’s attacks are all resolved.

Unless stated otherwise, destroyed models and units can’t use abilities and can’t be picked or targeted by rules.

An enemy unit or model counts as destroyed by you or your army only if one of your models’ attacks or one of your player rules destroyed it.
